_comment: Committed default price book for observability/pricing.py::estimate_cost. Operator overrides go in data/model_prices.json (layered OVER this file, picked up live via the TTL cache — no restart). Seeded faithfully from api_tracker._PRICES (per-1M-token) + _COHERE_PRICES_PER_CALL (flat per-call). Update when the provider list price changes; raw token/call counts are persisted in api_call so historical rows can be re-costed.

token._comment: USD per 1,000,000 tokens, as [input, output, cached_input]. Cached price applies to OpenAI prompt-caching (cached tokens are already counted inside prompt_tokens; estimate_cost subtracts them before applying the input price).

per_call._comment: USD per call (Cohere bills per rerank search, not per token). Document count inside the call does not change the price.
